name: Gaelic Gold

features.name: xNudge Wild
features.description: Three-row wilds that gain +1 per nudge.

features.name: Rainbow Spins
features.description: Triggered by a Pot of Gold in the centre.

review:
Gaelic Gold is a compact 3x3 Irish slot with a Medium volatility rating. A three-row xNudge Wild can land on any reel and always nudges into full view, adding +1 per nudge, and several wilds in one win add their multipliers together.

A Pot of Gold landing in the centre position starts Rainbow Spins: five spins to begin with, with chances to extend. The cap is 9,837x, a lot for such a small grid. A tidy introduction to how xNudge works.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
